
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xuyifei0302/p/22083473" title="发布于 2026-07-30 19:04">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">题解：beborder-53368 Vertex Cover</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><strong>省流：本做法最终时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n log^2 n)\)</span>，空间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span>。</strong></p>
<p>首先，这道题有一个最难的地方，就是我可以一直选到我已经染色的点，所以操作次数是没有上限的。</p>
<p>既然没有上限不好想，根据雷氏三定理发明者雷mini的著名论断：“当你发现没有思路时，不妨考虑考虑生成函数。”</p>
<p>于是，我们设我们在第 <span class="math inline">\(T\)</span> 次操作时停止，钦定在 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span> 次操作后我们还不是点覆盖，那么我们就确定了一个操作的上下界，则此时的期望就为 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{E}[T]=\sum_{t=0}^{\infty} P(T&gt;t)\)</span>。</p>
<p>根据容斥原理，对于任意一个大小为 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 的白色点集 <span class="math inline">\(S\)</span>，前 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span> 次操作恰好出现 <span class="math inline">\(S\)</span> 中所有点（且 <span class="math inline">\(S\)</span> 之外的点一次也未出现）的概率为：<span class="math inline">\(P(S)=\sum_{m=0}^{k}(-1)^{k-m}\binom{k}{m}\left(\frac{m}{n}\right)^t\)</span>。</p>
<p>因为次数实际无上限，所以要对 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span> 从 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(\infty\)</span> 求和（注意 <span class="math inline">\(m = 0\)</span> 时求和为 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(m &gt; 0\)</span> 时收敛于 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{n}{n-m}\)</span>），可得：<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{t=0}^{\infty}P(S)=\sum_{m=0}^{k}(-1)^{k-m}\binom{k}{m}\frac{n}{n-m}
=\frac{n}{(n-k)\binom{n}{k}}\)</span>。</p>
<p>为什么呢？我们来推导一下：</p>
<p>我们注意到：对于固定的 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>，构造这样一个有理函数：<span class="math inline">\(F(x)=\frac{k!}{x(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-k)}\)</span>，它的分母是连续整数乘积。这种有理函数可以拆成若干个“简单分式”之和：<span class="math inline">\(F(x)=\sum_{m=0}^{k} \frac{A_m}{x-m}\)</span>，其中每个 <span class="math inline">\(A_m\)</span> 是常数。</p>
<p>然后我们去计算 <span class="math inline">\(A_m\)</span>。为了求 <span class="math inline">\(A_m\)</span>，我们取极限（即用 <span class="math inline">\((x-m)\)</span> 乘以 <span class="math inline">\(F(x)\)</span>，再令 <span class="math inline">\(x\to m\)</span>）得到：<span class="math inline">\(A_m = \lim_{x\to m} (x-m)F(x)
= \frac{k!}{m(m-1)\cdots1 \cdot (m-(m+1))(m-(m+2))\cdots(m-k)}\)</span>。</p>
<p>我们计算两个乘积：</p>
<ul>
<li>前半：<span class="math inline">\(m(m-1)\cdots 1 = m!\)</span></li>
<li>后半：<span class="math inline">\((m-(m+1))(m-(m+2))\cdots(m-k) = (-1)(-2)\cdots(m-k) = (-1)^{k-m}(k-m)!\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>则有：<span class="math inline">\(A_m = \frac{k!}{m! \cdot (-1)^{k-m}(k-m)!}
= (-1)^{k-m}\binom{k}{m}\)</span>。</p>
<p>我们发现这个系数正好就是我们求和式里那个带符号的组合数。</p>
<p>因此，部分分式分解就为：<span class="math inline">\(\frac{k!}{x(x-1)\cdots(x-k)}
= \sum_{m=0}^{k} \frac{(-1)^{k-m}\binom{k}{m}}{x-m}\)</span>。</p>
<p>接着把 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 赋值为 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span>。因为树有 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个节点，且在这个推导中我们只关心 <span class="math inline">\(n&gt;k\)</span>，所以直接代入 <span class="math inline">\(x=n\)</span>，得到：<span class="math inline">\(\frac{k!}{n(n-1)\cdots(n-k)}
= \sum_{m=0}^{k} \frac{(-1)^{k-m}\binom{k}{m}}{n-m}\)</span>。</p>
<p>两边同时乘以 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span>，则：<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{m=0}^{k} (-1)^{k-m}\binom{k}{m}\frac{n}{n-m}
= \frac{n \cdot k!}{n(n-1)\cdots(n-k)}\)</span>。</p>
<p>右边分子分母约掉一个 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(= \frac{k!}{(n-1)(n-2)\cdots(n-k)}\)</span>。</p>
<p>最后把它写成组合数形式。我们现在得到：<span class="math inline">\(S = \frac{k!}{(n-1)(n-2)\cdots(n-k)}\)</span>。</p>
<p>因为 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{n}{(n-k)} \cdot \frac{k!(n-k)!}{n!}=\frac{n}{(n-k)\binom{n}{k}}\)</span> ，且 <span class="math inline">\((n-k)! = (n-k)(n-k-1)!\)</span>， <span class="math inline">\(n! = n(n-1)!\)</span>。</p>
<p>所以原式 <span class="math inline">\(= \frac{n}{(n-k)} \cdot \frac{k! \cdot (n-k)(n-k-1)!}{n(n-1)!}
= \frac{k! (n-k-1)!}{(n-1)!}\)</span>。<br>
而 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{k!}{(n-1)(n-2)\cdots(n-k)}\)</span> 上下同乘 <span class="math inline">\((n-k-1)!\)</span>，得到 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{k! (n-k-1)!}{(n-1)!}\)</span>。<br>
两者相同，因此：<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{m=0}^{k} (-1)^{k-m}\binom{k}{m}\frac{n}{n-m}
= \frac{n}{(n-k)\binom{n}{k}}\)</span>。</p>
<p>所以就有 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{E}[T]=\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq V\\ S\text{ 非独立集}}}\frac{n}{(n-|S|)\binom{n}{|S|}}\)</span>。</p>
<p>按大小 <span class="math inline">\(i=|S|\)</span> 分组，大小为 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 的集合共有 <span class="math inline">\(\binom{n}{i}\)</span> 个，其中独立集就是补集为顶点覆盖的个数为 <span class="math inline">\(f_{n-i}\)</span>。所以非独立集数量为 <span class="math inline">\(\binom{n}{i}-f_{n-i}\)</span>。令 <span class="math inline">\(k=n-i\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{E}[T]=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\left(1-\frac{f_i}{\binom{n}{i}}\right)\cdot \frac{n}{n-i}\)</span>。其中 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 表示大小为 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 的顶点覆盖数目。</p>
<p>我们考虑怎么计算 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span>。</p>
<p>我们对于每一个节点 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span>，定义两个生成函数 <span class="math inline">\(A_u\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(B_u\)</span>。其中 <span class="math inline">\(A_u(x)=\sum_{i} a_{u,i} x^i\)</span>，表示在 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 的子树内，且 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 不被选择时，顶点覆盖计数生成函数；<span class="math inline">\(B_u(x)=\sum_{i} b_{u,i} x^i\)</span> 表示在 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 的子树内，且 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 被选时，顶点覆盖计数生成函数。</p>
<p>那么，当 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 为叶节点时，<span class="math inline">\(A_u(x)=1\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(B_u(x)=x\)</span> 因为如果不选，子树没有点，方案数为 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>；如果选，则要消耗 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个顶点。</p>
<p>接着，当 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 为非叶子节点时，则有：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>若不选 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span>，则每条边 <span class="math inline">\((u,v)\)</span> 必须由 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 覆盖，所以每个子节点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 必须选，贡献为 <span class="math inline">\(B_v(x)\)</span>，故 <span class="math inline">\(A_u(x)=\prod_{v\in \text{son}(u)} B_v(x)\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>若选 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span>，则子节点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 可选可不选，贡献为 <span class="math inline">\(A_v(x)+B_v(x)\)</span>，且 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 本身被选乘上 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，则为 <span class="math inline">\(B_u(x)=x\cdot \prod_{v\in \text{son}(u)} \big(A_v(x)+B_v(x)\big)\)</span>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>则整体的生成函数为：<span class="math inline">\(F(x)=A_{\text{root}}(x)+B_{\text{root}}(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{n} f_i x^i\)</span>。</p>
<p>所以，我们可以用 NTT 来进行计算 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span>，因为每次我们只关心当前节点和其儿子，并不关心孙子及以下的点，所以整体时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n log^2 n)\)</span>，空间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span>。</p>
<p>下面给出代码（要卡卡常，不然会被 <span class="math inline">\(n^2\)</span> 创飞）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define int long long
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 998244353, g = 3;
struct Node {
	bool operator()(const vector&lt;int&gt;* x, const vector&lt;int&gt;* y) const{
		return x-&gt;size() &gt; y-&gt;size();
	}
};
int n, F[400005], G[400005], fac[100005], inv[100005];
vector&lt;int&gt; graph[100005], dp[100005], dp1[100005];
int ksm(int x, int y) {
	int res = 1;
	while (y) {
		if (y &amp; 1) {
			res *= x;
			res %= MOD;
		}
		x *= x;
		x %= MOD;
		y &gt;&gt;= 1;
	}
	return res;
}
int C(int x, int y) {
	if (x &lt; y || y &lt; 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	return fac[x] * inv[y] % MOD * inv[x - y] % MOD;
}
void NTT(int A[], int len, int op) {
	for (int i = 1, j = 0; i &lt; len; i ++) {
		int pos = len &gt;&gt; 1;
		for (; j &amp; pos; pos &gt;&gt;= 1) {
			j ^= pos;
		}
		j ^= pos;
		if (i &lt; j) {
			swap(A[i], A[j]);
		}
	}
	for (int i = 2; i &lt;= len; i *= 2) {
		int wlen = ksm(g, (MOD - 1) / i);
		if (op) {
			wlen = ksm(wlen, MOD - 2);
		}
		for (int j = 0; j &lt; len; j += i) {
			int w = 1;
			for (int k = 0; k &lt; i / 2; k ++) {
				int x = A[j + k], y = w * A[j + k + i / 2] % MOD;
				A[j + k] = (x + y) % MOD;
				A[j + k + i / 2] = (x - y + MOD) % MOD;
				w *= wlen;
				w %= MOD;
			}
		}
	}
	if (op) {
		int ni = ksm(len, MOD - 2);
		for (int i = 0; i &lt; len; i ++) {
			A[i] *= ni;
			A[i] %= MOD;
		}
	}
}
vector&lt;int&gt; work(const vector&lt;int&gt;&amp; x, const vector&lt;int&gt;&amp; y) {
	if (x.empty() || y.empty()) {
		vector&lt;int&gt; tmp;
		return tmp;
	}
	int lenx = x.size(), leny = y.size(), newlen = lenx + leny - 1, len = 1;
	while (len &lt; newlen) {
		len *= 2;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i &lt; lenx; i ++) {
		F[i] = x[i];
	}
	for (int i = lenx; i &lt; len; i ++) {
		F[i] = 0;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i &lt; leny; i ++) {
		G[i] = y[i];
	}
	for (int i = leny; i &lt; len; i ++) {
		G[i] = 0;
	}
	NTT(F, len, 0);
	NTT(G, len, 0);
	for (int i = 0; i &lt; len; i ++) {
		F[i] *= G[i];
		F[i] %= MOD;
	}
	NTT(F, len, 1);
	vector&lt;int&gt; res;
	for (int i = 0; i &lt; newlen; i ++) {
		res.push_back(F[i]);
	}
	return res;
}
vector&lt;int&gt; change(vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt;&amp; x) {
	if (x.empty()) {
		return {1};
	}
	if (x.size() == 1) {
		return move(x[0]);
	}
	deque&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt; dq;
	priority_queue&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;*, vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;*&gt;, Node&gt; pq;
	for (auto&amp; i : x) {
		dq.push_back(move(i));
		pq.push(&amp;dq.back());
	}
	while (pq.size() &gt; 1) {
		vector&lt;int&gt;* xx = pq.top();
		pq.pop();
		vector&lt;int&gt;* yy = pq.top();
		pq.pop();
		dq.push_back(work(*xx, *yy));
		pq.push(&amp;dq.back());
	}
	return move(*pq.top());
}
void dfs(int u, int father) {
	vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt; sondp1, chF;
	for (auto i : graph[u]) {
		if (i == father) {
			continue;
		}
		dfs(i, u);
		vector&lt;int&gt; ff = dp[i];
		for (int j = 0; j &lt; dp1[i].size(); j ++) {
			if (j &lt; ff.size()) {
				ff[j] = (ff[j] + dp1[i][j]) % MOD;
			} else {
				ff.push_back(dp1[i][j]);
			}
		}
		chF.push_back(move(ff));
		sondp1.push_back(move(dp1[i]));
	}
	vector&lt;int&gt; prod_dp1 = change(sondp1), prod_F = change(chF), b(prod_F.size() + 1, 0);
	for (int i = 0; i &lt; prod_F.size(); i ++) {
		b[i + 1] = prod_F[i];
	}
	dp[u] = move(prod_dp1);
	dp1[u] = move(b);
}
signed main() {
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(0);
	cout.tie(0);
	fac[0] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i &lt;= 100000; i ++) {
		fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
	}
	inv[100000] = ksm(fac[100000], MOD - 2);
	for (int i = 99999; i &gt;= 0; i --) {
		inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD;
	}
	cin &gt;&gt; n;
	for (int i = 1; i &lt; n; i ++) {
		int x, y;
		cin &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y;
		graph[x].push_back(y);
		graph[y].push_back(x);
	}
	dfs(1, 1);
	vector&lt;int&gt; f(n + 5, 0);
	for (int i = 0; i &lt;= n; i ++) {
		if (i &lt; dp[1].size()) {
			f[i] += dp[1][i];
			f[i] %= MOD;
		}
		if (i &lt; dp1[1].size()) {
			f[i] += dp1[1][i];
			f[i] %= MOD;
		}
	}
	int ans = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; i ++) {
		ans += (1 - f[i] * ksm(C(n, i), MOD - 2) % MOD + MOD) % MOD * n % MOD * ksm(n - i, MOD - 2) % MOD;
		ans %= MOD;
	}
	cout &lt;&lt; ans;
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
